allowed: Read /nodes UI; inspect existing Enrollment dialog; copy/read actual command only if already available in UI; for successful/denied clipboard test use fresh real preview and same-origin browser clipboard; classify inventory NOT_RUN cases.
forbidden: Do not submit enrollment; do not create Node, Agent, User, Task, Run, or any resource; do not reveal/record command, token, clipboard text, or screenshot including command region; do not alter service/global settings.

decision: The real UI has no existing command preview or Copy button before a new enrollment POST. Because this batch explicitly forbids enrollment submission and resource creation, do not fabricate a clipboard sample or click Copy; P05A-10 remains PARTIAL pending an explicitly permitted disposable preview source or enrollment POST fixture. No conclusion about copy success/failure behavior is made.
